title: 🔥 DO NOT GO BEYOND WHAT IS WRITTEN! WHY GOD COMMANDS US TO FOLLOW HIS WORD ALONE!
paragraphs:
🔥 DO NOT GO BEYOND WHAT IS WRITTEN! WHY GOD COMMANDS US TO FOLLOW HIS WORD ALONE!
💭 READER QUESTION:
"Brother John, I’ve heard people say we should only follow what the Bible says, but others add traditions, personal revelations, and church doctrines. What does the Bible really say?"
🔥 EXCELLENT QUESTION! Many today ignore God's Word and follow man-made teachings, traditions, and emotions. But the Apostle Paul gave a clear warning—do NOT go beyond what is written!

📖 1 Corinthians 4:6 (KJV)
"And these things, brethren, I have in a figure transferred to myself and to Apollos for your sakes; that ye might learn in us not to think of men above that which is written, that no one of you be puffed up for one against another."

🚨 THE TRUTH:
✔️ God's Word is the FINAL authority—no tradition, opinion, or church doctrine should add to it!
✔️ False teachers elevate themselves above Scripture, leading people astray.
✔️ Pride causes division—many think their opinions are more important than the Bible!
🔥 WHAT DOES IT MEAN TO "NOT GO BEYOND WHAT IS WRITTEN"? HOW CAN WE APPLY THIS TODAY?
💡 QUESTION: Are you following the Bible alone, or are you influenced by human traditions and false teachings?
🚀 NOW LET’S EXPLORE THE REAL MEANING BEHIND 1 CORINTHIANS 4:6!

THE TRUE MEANING OF 1 CORINTHIANS 4:6 – WHY WE MUST NOT GO BEYOND WHAT IS WRITTEN!
Many today misinterpret or ignore this verse, but Paul was very clear: Christians must not add to God's Word or elevate human teachings above Scripture.

📖 1 Corinthians 4:6 (KJV)
"That ye might learn in us not to think of men above that which is written, that no one of you be puffed up for one against another."

🚨 WHAT DOES THIS MEAN?
✔️ The Bible is the highest authority—no one should add or take away from it.
✔️ Paul was warning against elevating human leaders and traditions above God's Word.
✔️ Pride and arrogance lead people to follow men instead of Scripture!
🔥 NOW, LET’S BREAK THIS DOWN FURTHER!

✅ 1. GOD'S WORD IS THE FINAL AUTHORITY—NO ADDITIONS ALLOWED!
🔥 The biggest problem in Christianity today is that people add their own teachings to the Bible!

📖 Deuteronomy 4:2 (KJV)
"Ye shall not add unto the word which I command you, neither shall ye diminish ought from it, that ye may keep the commandments of the Lord your God which I command you."

✔️ Religious leaders often create man-made rules and traditions that have no biblical basis!
✔️ This is exactly what the Pharisees did—and Jesus rebuked them for it!
✔️ We must follow ONLY what is written in Scripture, nothing more, nothing less!
🚨 THE TRUTH: If it is not in the Bible, it should not be followed as a command from God!
💡 QUESTION: Are you following traditions that are not found in Scripture?

✅ 2. PRIDE AND DIVISION COME FROM ELEVATING HUMAN TEACHINGS!
🔥 Many Christians fight and divide because they follow human leaders instead of the Bible!

📖 1 Corinthians 1:12-13 (KJV)
"Now this I say, that every one of you saith, I am of Paul; and I of Apollos; and I of Cephas; and I of Christ. Is Christ divided?"

✔️ People were following church leaders instead of Christ—just like today!
✔️ Religious organizations claim authority over Scripture, leading many into deception.
✔️ Paul warned against this because it leads to spiritual pride and division!
🚨 THE TRUTH: The Bible warns us to follow CHRIST, not men!
💡 QUESTION: Are you following Jesus, or are you blindly trusting religious leaders?

✅ 3. FALSE TEACHINGS SPREAD WHEN PEOPLE IGNORE SCRIPTURE!
🔥 Many false doctrines exist today because people go beyond what is written!

📖 Mark 7:7-8 (KJV)
"Howbeit in vain do they worship me, teaching for doctrines the commandments of men. For laying aside the commandment of God, ye hold the tradition of men."

✔️ False religions and cults all have one thing in common—they go beyond Scripture!
✔️ Many churches today elevate traditions, councils, and popes over the Bible.
✔️ When people add to God’s Word, they open the door to deception!
🚨 THE TRUTH: If a teaching cannot be proven in Scripture, it is NOT from God!
💡 QUESTION: Are you testing every doctrine against the Bible, or are you just accepting what others say?

✅ 4. SATAN WANTS PEOPLE TO ADD TO GOD’S WORD – JUST LIKE HE DID IN THE GARDEN OF EDEN!
🔥 The very first deception happened because Satan twisted God’s Word—and Eve added to it!

📖 Genesis 3:1-3 (KJV)
"Now the serpent was more subtil than any beast of the field which the Lord God had made. And he said unto the woman, Yea, hath God said, Ye shall not eat of every tree of the garden? And the woman said unto the serpent, We may eat of the fruit of the trees of the garden: But of the fruit of the tree which is in the midst of the garden, God hath said, Ye shall not eat of it, neither shall ye touch it, lest ye die."

✔️ God never said, "neither shall ye touch it"—Eve added to His command!
✔️ This opened the door for Satan to deceive her!
✔️ When people add to God’s Word, they make it easier for Satan to twist the truth!
🚨 THE TRUTH: Satan loves when people add traditions, extra rules, and false doctrines—because it weakens the true Gospel!
💡 QUESTION: Have you accepted religious teachings that go beyond what is written in the Bible?

✅ 5. THE BIBLE WARNS THAT MANY WILL BE DECEIVED BY TEACHINGS THAT ARE NOT WRITTEN!
🔥 Paul warned that in the last days, many people would believe false teachings instead of God’s Word!

📖 2 Timothy 4:3-4 (KJV)
"For the time will come when they will not endure sound doctrine; but after their own lusts shall they heap to themselves teachers, having itching ears; And they shall turn away their ears from the truth, and shall be turned unto fables."

✔️ Many churches today are filled with "feel-good" teachings that are NOT in the Bible!
✔️ People chase emotional experiences instead of biblical truth!
✔️ Many religious groups add extra books, visions, and false revelations to deceive people!
🚨 THE TRUTH: If a teaching is not grounded in the Bible, it is NOT from God!
💡 QUESTION: Are you standing firm on biblical truth, or are you being led by emotions and traditions?

✅ 6. JESUS WARNED THAT RELIGIOUS LEADERS WOULD GO BEYOND SCRIPTURE!
🔥 The Pharisees had the Scriptures, but they still created their own religious system!

📖 Matthew 15:9 (KJV)
"But in vain they do worship me, teaching for doctrines the commandments of men."

✔️ The Pharisees elevated their traditions ABOVE God’s commands!
✔️ They followed religious rules that were not in Scripture, leading many into deception.
✔️ Jesus rebuked them because they valued human teachings over the Word of God!
🚨 THE TRUTH: Many churches today are no different from the Pharisees—they place human traditions above God’s Word!
💡 QUESTION: Are you following Jesus or religious traditions made by men?

✅ 7. THE FINAL WARNING – DO NOT ADD OR TAKE AWAY FROM GOD’S WORD!
🔥 The Bible begins and ends with a command—DO NOT ADD OR TAKE AWAY!

📖 Proverbs 30:5-6 (KJV)
"Every word of God is pure: he is a shield unto them that put their trust in him. Add thou not unto his words, lest he reprove thee, and thou be found a liar."

📖 Revelation 22:18-19 (KJV)
"For I testify unto every man that heareth the words of the prophecy of this book, If any man shall add unto these things, God shall add unto him the plagues that are written in this book: And if any man shall take away from the words of the book of this prophecy, God shall take away his part out of the book of life."

✔️ God takes His Word so seriously that He warns of severe judgment for those who alter it!
✔️ Adding or removing anything from Scripture is a dangerous sin that leads to destruction!
✔️ We are called to preach the pure, unaltered Word of God—without compromise!
🚨 THE TRUTH: Many false religions have been created by adding or removing parts of God’s Word—but true followers of Christ will obey what is written!
💡 QUESTION: Are you standing on the pure Word of God, or have you accepted teachings that go beyond Scripture?
🚀🔥 NOW THAT WE UNDERSTAND THE TRUE MEANING OF 1 CORINTHIANS 4:6, HOW CAN WE APPLY THIS TO OUR LIVES?

HOW TO LIVE BY SCRIPTURE ALONE AND AVOID DECEPTION!
Now that we understand why we must not go beyond what is written, the next step is learning how to apply this truth to our daily lives!

📖 2 Timothy 3:16-17 (KJV)
"All scripture is given by inspiration of God, and is profitable for doctrine, for reproof, for correction, for instruction in righteousness: That the man of God may be perfect, thoroughly furnished unto all good works."

🚨 HOW CAN WE ENSURE THAT WE FOLLOW ONLY GOD’S WORD AND NOT MAN-MADE TEACHINGS?
✔️ Test Every Teaching Against Scripture!
✔️ Reject Any Teaching That Adds to the Bible!
✔️ Be Rooted in the Word—Read and Study Daily!
✔️ Ask the Holy Spirit for Discernment!
✔️ Expose and Correct False Teachings with Biblical Truth!
🔥 NOW, LET’S BREAK THESE STEPS DOWN INTO ACTIONABLE STEPS!

✅ 1. TEST EVERY TEACHING AGAINST SCRIPTURE!
🔥 If it does not match the Bible, reject it!

📖 Acts 17:11 (KJV)
"These were more noble than those in Thessalonica, in that they received the word with all readiness of mind, and searched the scriptures daily, whether those things were so."

✔️ The Bereans didn’t just believe what they were told—they checked Scripture!
✔️ Many Christians today blindly accept what their pastors, priests, or leaders say without verifying it in the Bible.
✔️ God expects us to TEST everything by His Word!
🚨 THE TRUTH: If a teaching is not found in the Bible, it is not from God!
💡 QUESTION: Are you testing what you hear, or just accepting what others say?

✅ 2. REJECT ANY TEACHING THAT ADDS TO THE BIBLE!
🔥 No visions, traditions, or religious councils have the right to change God’s Word!

📖 Galatians 1:8 (KJV)
"But though we, or an angel from heaven, preach any other gospel unto you than that which we have preached unto you, let him be accursed."

✔️ Even if an "angel" brings a different gospel, it must be rejected!
✔️ Religious leaders who claim authority over Scripture are in direct rebellion against God.
✔️ Many cults started by adding "new revelations"—but God’s Word is complete!
🚨 THE TRUTH: The Bible is ENOUGH—God doesn’t need human traditions or extra books!
💡 QUESTION: Are you following only what the Bible says, or are you influenced by extra teachings?

✅ 3. BE ROOTED IN THE WORD—READ AND STUDY DAILY!
🔥 The best way to avoid deception is to KNOW the truth!

📖 Joshua 1:8 (KJV)
"This book of the law shall not depart out of thy mouth; but thou shalt meditate therein day and night, that thou mayest observe to do according to all that is written therein: for then thou shalt make thy way prosperous, and then thou shalt have good success."

✔️ A Christian who doesn’t read the Bible is easily deceived.
✔️ Daily Bible study will protect you from false teachings.
✔️ When you know the Word, you will recognize deception immediately!
🚨 THE TRUTH: A believer without the Bible is like a soldier without a weapon!
💡 QUESTION: Are you spending daily time in God’s Word, or are you spiritually starving?

✅ 4. ASK THE HOLY SPIRIT FOR DISCERNMENT!
🔥 The Holy Spirit is our Teacher—He helps us understand Scripture!

📖 John 16:13 (KJV)
"Howbeit when he, the Spirit of truth, is come, he will guide you into all truth."

✔️ The Holy Spirit will NEVER contradict Scripture.
✔️ If someone claims the Spirit "revealed" something that goes against the Bible, it’s a lie!
✔️ God gives discernment to those who sincerely seek the truth!
🚨 THE TRUTH: If you rely only on human teachers without seeking the Holy Spirit, you are vulnerable to deception!
💡 QUESTION: Are you asking God for wisdom and discernment daily?

✅ 5. EXPOSE AND CORRECT FALSE TEACHINGS WITH BIBLICAL TRUTH!
🔥 We are commanded to expose false doctrines and protect others from deception!

📖 Ephesians 5:11 (KJV)
"And have no fellowship with the unfruitful works of darkness, but rather reprove them."

✔️ Many Christians stay silent about false teachings out of fear—but God calls us to speak the truth!
✔️ Correcting falsehood is an act of love—it saves people from deception!
✔️ When false doctrines are confronted with Scripture, they collapse!
🚨 THE TRUTH: If you remain silent about false teachings, you allow deception to spread!
💡 QUESTION: Are you standing for truth, or are you afraid to confront false teachings?
🚀🔥 NOW THAT WE KNOW HOW TO LIVE BY SCRIPTURE ALONE, THE QUESTION IS—WILL YOU TAKE ACTION?

THE FINAL CHALLENGE – WILL YOU STAND FIRM ON GOD’S WORD OR FOLLOW MAN-MADE TEACHINGS?
💭 THE MOMENT OF DECISION IS HERE!
Now that you know the truth, what will you do? Will you stand firm on God’s Word alone, or will you follow traditions, false doctrines, and human opinions?

📖 Matthew 7:24-25 (KJV)
"Therefore whosoever heareth these sayings of mine, and doeth them, I will liken him unto a wise man, which built his house upon a rock: And the rain descended, and the floods came, and the winds blew, and beat upon that house; and it fell not: for it was founded upon a rock."

🚨 THE REALITY:
✔️ God’s Word is the only foundation that will never fail!
✔️ Religious traditions will collapse, but Scripture stands forever.
✔️ Satan wants to lead people away from the Bible—DON’T FALL FOR IT!
🔥 WHAT WILL YOU CHOOSE?
💡 QUESTION: Are you building your faith on Scripture alone, or on the shifting sands of human teachings?

🚨 MANY TODAY IGNORE THIS WARNING – DON’T BE ONE OF THEM!
📖 Hosea 4:6 (KJV)
"My people are destroyed for lack of knowledge: because thou hast rejected knowledge, I will also reject thee."

🚨 THINK ABOUT THIS:
❌ Many people claim to be Christians but never study the Bible for themselves.
❌ Some churches elevate man-made traditions over God’s Word.
❌ Many believers trust religious leaders without testing their teachings against Scripture.

🔥 THIS MEANS:
✔️ You must be rooted in the Bible, not in church traditions!
✔️ You must test EVERY teaching, no matter who says it!
✔️ You must seek truth for yourself—don’t let others control your faith!
🚨 THE WARNING: If you follow man-made teachings instead of the Bible, you are in danger of being deceived!
💡 QUESTION: Are you willing to break free from false teachings and stand on Scripture alone?

🔥 THIS MAY BE YOUR LAST CHANCE TO CHOOSE TRUTH!
The truth has been spoken. You cannot unread this or pretend you never heard it.

🚨 WHAT WILL YOU DO NOW?
❌ Ignore this message and continue following religious traditions?
✔️ Take action TODAY and commit to following God’s Word alone!

📖 John 8:31-32 (KJV)
"If ye continue in my word, then are ye my disciples indeed; And ye shall know the truth, and the truth shall make you free."
🔥 GOD’S WORD IS ENOUGH! STAND ON IT AND NEVER COMPROMISE!
